items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well when we went to Japan on one of George Wein’s tours. This was supposed to be like the drum battle so it was Art Blakey, Tony Williams and myself. Oh yeah Wayne Shorter, Ben Tucker.

ctx.x: So you met him again, four years later, how did that happen?
